ranked_facts.why: The presence of unilateral purulent nasal discharge mixed with blood is more consistent with a nasal foreign body, which would cause a localized infection, than with other candidates such as infectious processes of the nasal cavity, inflammatory processes, or neoplastic processes, which might present with more bilateral or systemic symptoms.

The unilaterality of symptoms, such as discharge and pain, points more towards an anatomical obstruction like a foreign body, which would affect one side of the nasal cavity, rather than conditions that typically cause bilateral symptoms.
